description: This file implements quantized tensor clamp operations for CPU in the PyTorch library, including QNNPACK integration and various clamp functions.

methods.name: qnnpack_clamp
methods.description: Performs quantized clamp operation using QNNPACK if available.

methods.name: quantized_clamp_impl
methods.description: Main implementation of quantized clamp handling optional min/max and QNNPACK.

methods.description: Performs hardtanh (clamp with default min/max) on quantized tensor.
